card.name: Literary and film analysis technique words
card.fires_on: Small words like "to", "the", "us" or "against" in essay-style analysis of how an author or filmmaker uses a technique. They come right before the thing the technique conveys or depicts.

modes.label: Technique used to do something
modes.description: The word "to" after an author or filmmaker "uses" or "use" a device, before a verb of constructing or separating.
modes.example: which filmmakers use<< to>> construct a variety of messages

modes.label: Craft nouns in art analysis
modes.description: The noun "composition" or phrases like "point of view" in discussion of art, film or narrative form.
modes.example: evident in their<< composition>>, outline, and emotional vibrancy.

modes.label: Linking word in literary commentary
modes.description: A linking word such as "us", "the" or "against" inside study-guide commentary on how a text works.
modes.example: prepares<< us>> for the way family will function in the

card.writes: It pushes toward words about depiction and technique, such as "手法", "描写", "portrayal" and "刻画".
card.plain: It marks essay passages explaining how a writer or filmmaker uses technique to portray something.
